name: TheftBlox
desc:
TheftBlox is an open-world multiplayer game where you can explore the city of Ro Theftos, purchase weapons, race cars, evade the police, and more. You can team up with friends or compete against others in fights, races, and various activities, while roaming the streets of the city. The game offers continuous various content, ensuring endless action and chaos.

NEW UPDATE!
Added police, wanted level, helicopters, weapon and car saving, improved graphics, various bug fixes, and more.
